Items.text: Finally! What took you guys so— ...wait. You're not my goons.
Items.name: The Hole

Items.text: Where'd everybody go? Where's the MONEY?
Items.name: The Hole

Items.text: The letters said the bags would come right back out through me. They said I'd get my cut!
Items.name: The Hole

Items.text: Not A Hole, I'm THE Hole! Supervillain of getting into even the most restricted spaces.
Items.name: The Hole

Items.text: I can make myself the hole in any wall... as long as it's not thicker than me. Which this vault is.
Items.name: The Hole

Items.text: So if I'm stuck in here, kid, you're stuck in here with me!
Items.name: The Hole
